name: Fujiwara no Kunihara
source:
Fujiwara no Hidehira is the eldest son of Hidehira, and he is a gentle and friendly person who is a half-brother to Yasuhira. 

At that time, it was a power struggle or a clan survival. It was a sad time when brothers often fought and killed each other. Nevertheless, Kunihira, who tries to support Yasuhira as a general, is a really good brother.
